OpenAI.// ChatCompletionsDeployment: Single source of truth for non-prod. Production overrides this via the literal OpenAI__ChatCompletionsDeployment app setting in infra/main.bicep. Must match a live deployment on po-aiservices-shared.

// ImageGen: Feature flag — switches the image-generation provider without a redeploy. 'google' = Gemini 2.5 Flash Image (cheapest working path); 'huggingface' = FLUX/Qwen via HuggingFace Inference Providers (currently broken: fal-ai provider not routing these models, see HF:ImageToImageProviderId).
// HuggingFace: Set ApiKey (user-secrets/Key Vault) to a token with the 'Inference Providers' permission. Routes fal-native as {BaseUrl}/{Provider}/{providerId}. NOTE 2026-07: the configured fal-ai/{flux/schnell,qwen-image-edit} providerIds currently return HTTP 400 'Model not supported by provider fal-ai' on the HF router — fal-ai appears to have stopped routing them. Image generation via HF is therefore unavailable until the provider catalog is updated. Chat completions ({BaseUrl}/v1/chat/completions) and Qwen VL vision still work.

HuggingFace.// ChatModel: OpenAI-compatible chat model used by the Style Director reasoning agents ({BaseUrl}/v1/chat/completions). VisionModel must accept image inputs. Both must be enabled on your Inference-Providers token.

// AiPricing: Indicative USD list prices per 1024x1024 image, shown in the UI as estimates (not billed amounts). Keyed by ImageGen:Provider value.
